Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner unnecessarily changed the comparison criterion to “US release dates” (and even suggested a 2015 US home video date for Dis-Moi Qui Tuer) instead of using the films’ earliest original release dates. The task simply asks which film came out earlier; globally, Dis-Moi Qui Tuer (1965) is clearly earlier than Under the Hawthorn Tree (2010). This misinterpretation/normalization could invert the correct outcome by comparing disparate US availability dates rather than the initial release dates.
